exposure: IGF-1 levels in umbilical cord blood
IGF-BP3 levels in umbilical cord blood
IGF-BP5 levels in umbilical cord blood
cohort: The study evaluated 80 infants (20 diagnosed with DDH and 60 healthy controls) who were born to mothers with high-risk pregnancies for DDH at 37-42 weeks of gestation.
finding: IGF-BP5 values in umbilical cord blood were significantly lower in infants diagnosed with DDH compared to healthy controls.
birth_weight: Matched between groups for birth weight.
gest_age: 37-42 weeks; matched between groups for gestational week.
